messages:
alex: Quick sync on a cluster of repeat failures in Dedicated GPU pools. Over the last ~3 weeks we see ~6 regressions where nodes fail to finish warmup and requests fallback to lower-capacity pools. I pulled the incidents and grouped by signature; preliminary hypotheses below and proposed owners/timelines. Need owners and an ops/eng plan. :eyes:

maya: thanks alex. can you share the signatures and an example log?

alex: sure — common signatures: 
- failed kernel module init during warmup (exit 127)
- NVSwitch fw mismatch causing driver panic
- autoscaler preemption race where pod evicted while kv-cache warming

example log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:07Z] warmup: loading model shards...
[2026-03-15T02:14:09Z] error: modprobe nvidia_uvm failed (exit 127)
[2026-03-15T02:14:10Z] node-controller: marking node NotReady -> drain -> eviction
```

tj: NVSwitch mismatch rings a bell; we had a vendor firmware rollout in us-west on 2026-02-28. did we pin firmware on the dedicated pools?

sam: we didn't pin — infra rolled that out automatically. I can check the rollout tags.

leah: autoscale race sounds painful. is that coming from kube-proxy healthcheck timing? or our custom scaler?

priya: my read: two distinct buckets — infra (firmware/driver/AMI) and orchestration (autoscaler race). both produce the same customer-visible symptom (fallback to shared pools).

oncall-bot: [ALERT] 1954329801 repeated_node_warmup_failures detected for pool:redwood-dedicated-usw-01 (5 failures in 24h)

alex: Proposed immediate actions (short-term mitigation, 2 business days):
- sam -> rollback vendor firmware on affected hosts (blocker) — due 2026-03-24 EOD. (owner: sam)
- maya -> add probe to pre-warm step to detect modprobe failure and retry once, log richer error (owner: maya) — due 2026-03-24 EOD.
- tj -> create a canary on 2 nodes with pinned AMI + firmware for next 48h (owner: tj) — due 2026-03-24 noon.

longer-term (next 2-6 weeks):
- leah -> autoscaler change: add lease/lock to avoid double-eviction when warmups in-flight (owner: leah) — proposed due 2026-04-10.
- priya -> incident bucketization and dashboards: create a top-5 signature dashboard, link to runbooks, track recurrence rate (owner: priya) — due 2026-04-03.
- infra eng -> lifecycle: formalize firmware pinning for Dedicated pools and add rollout gating (owner: sam + infra team) — due 2026-04-15.

sam: acked on rollback. I'll open tracker ticket and post link here.

maya: i'll do the probe + small retry; will try to keep change behind a feature flag.

leah: for autoscaler I'll draft the lock design; needs a quick review from infra and eng-runtime.

priya: I'll start the dashboard. what metric do we want as the primary signal? failure_rate or fallback_rate? fallback_rate might be higher-level.

alex: fallback_rate as primary (customer-visible), failure_rate as secondary for debugging. Add sample query to dashboard: `sum(rate(fallbacks_total[1h])) by (pool)`

sam: created INC-5412 and linked to tracker: https://go/internal/INC-5412 — rollback plan included.

oncall-bot: [NOTE] INC-5412 assigned to sam; priority: high.

tj: can we also add a temporary routing rule to prefer pools with recent successful warmups? low-risk throttle until fixes land.

alex: yes good idea. add as short-term config: route-preference=recent-warmup-success (owner: maya) — due 2026-03-24 EOD.

maya: adding config flag to dedicated router. will test in staging.

priya: gathering historical list of similar incidents. preliminary cluster: 2026-02-14, 2026-02-28, 2026-03-03, 2026-03-12, 2026-03-15, 2026-03-18 — looks like weekly spikes after vendor rollouts. I'll attach the CSV to INC-5412.

leah: for tracking: can we add a column "recurrence_hypothesis" on the tracker — so postmortem follow-ups can mark which hypothesis the action is addressing? reduces future churn.

alex: yes please. priya, add that field to the ticket template and dashboard filter.

sam: rollback underway — ETA 90m for node re-provision. will post updates in this thread.

[~2 hours later]

sam: rollback completed for 8 nodes in usw-01. warmup success rate on those nodes moved from 72% -> 98% over last hour. :white_check_mark:

alex: excellent. please attach logs to INC-5412 and assign follow-up owners for postmortem items.

priya: dashboard draft up at https://go/internal/dashboards/repeat-warmup-failures — added recurrence table and primary/secondary metrics. feedback welcome.

leah: putting autoscaler lock PR in my queue. aiming for a small design doc and PR by end of next week.

maya: feature flag deployed to staging; probe logs look good. will coordinate with tj for canary nodes.

tj: canary nodes with pinned AMI created; no failures in 24h. holding observation for another 24h.

alex: next steps: owners to update INC-5412 with final remediation plan, link runbooks, and mark expected completion dates. we'll re-evaluate recurrence in 2 weeks and close or escalate. thanks all. :bow:

priya: I'll schedule a 30m retro in #incidents for 2026-03-26 to summarize learnings and ensure action items are tracked.

sam: noted — will add rollback playbook items to infra runbook.

leah: will tag eng-runtime for review on lock PR.

alex: thread closed for now; reopen if any regressions appear.
